comparison.objective: Raise and rotate a monitor to a target portrait pose using spring-axis release buttons.
comparison.physical_skill: Button-hold coordination, constrained-axis motion, and stable stand control.
comparison.success_condition: Height, pivot, and tilt remain within tolerance for 20 seconds after release without force or contact violations.
comparison.reason: Both involve spring mechanisms and bimanual coordination, but this record tests controlled axis adjustment; the candidate tests physical attachment of a separate rail at four rack holes plus screws.
